scope: Primboard safe Mac candidate preparation and encrypted process-crash recovery; no signed/private-store release claim

ci.skip_policy: The subprocess-only crash helper skips in the parent run and executes in five child processes. Optional installed Docket integrations skip when the tool is absent. Scheduled cases are not presented as a count of ordinary passed tests.
ci.limitations: This is arm64 macOS CI with synthetic data and test keys; it does not demonstrate x86_64, real hardware power loss, company signing/notarization, TCC, or an existing private notebook.

behavior: Publish one authenticated encrypted PPJ1 redo record before changing referenced blobs or index; publication is the commit point.
Recover under the existing interprocess lock before index or direct payload/image reads and before mutations.
Authenticate and validate complete old/new index state, revisions, payloads, lengths/fingerprints, paths and filename aliases before replay changes a file.
Replay changed blobs, the matching index and precise obsolete-file deletion idempotently; retain invalid or unfinished records.
Require synced directory entries and macOS F_FULLFSYNC barriers; unsupported filesystems fail rather than silently weaken the requested durability.
Persist derived tabs and derive legacy tab timestamps from source items instead of the current clock.
A post-publication error may represent a committed change; reload/reconcile before repeating an operation.
journal.compatibility: PPI3 index and notebook model versions 1/2 remain. Bundle sh.prims.paste, executable PrimsPaste, CLI prims-paste, original Keychain identity and notebook path remain. Both app and CLI must be journal-aware; older binaries must not access a pending journal.

safe_mac_candidate_tooling.behavior: Check usable company signing access before side-building an immutable source candidate; never replace the installed app from the build script. Preserve notarization submission IDs, verify accepted archive hashes, staple a copy and verify final unpacked artifacts.
safe_mac_candidate_tooling.limitations: Tests mock company signing and Apple service responses; no live signed/notarized release or installed notebook acceptance was performed.
